surfaceMeaning: Standard grid on a source-informed shape model; no resolved global surface map.
name: Varuna
credit: Fernández-Valenzuela et al. (2019), ApJL; multi-epoch rotational photometry
shapeMeaning: Illustrative scale model of the published Jacobi fit: b/a=0.60, c/b=0.72, scaled to the paper’s adopted approximate 700 km volume-equivalent diameter. These smooth axes are inferred, not resolved terrain.
orientationMeaning: Uses one published pole interpretation, ecliptic longitude 53° ±10° and latitude −64° ±6°, converted with the J2000 mean obliquity for display. The antipodal pole is also allowed; equinox and meridian are display conventions, not a qualified absolute attitude.
periodText: About 6.34357 hours from photometry; display phase is illustrative
introduction: Varuna’s rapid rotation and changing brightness reveal an elongated world beyond Neptune. This smooth model follows a published light-curve fit; its absolute size remains approximate.

numericEvidence.scaleMeaning: The same paper adopts approximately 700 km volume-equivalent diameter for its satellite discussion; this is an approximate model scale, not an occultation-derived 3D diameter.

unresolved: Absolute dimensions remain uncertain: thermal scale and the reported 2010 occultation chord are in tension.
The shortest axis depends on hydrostatic equilibrium; the data also allow a nearby non-equilibrium fit.
The 2019 satellite signal is a candidate, not a qualified companion for this package.

sourceSurvey.provides: Three-dimensional axis ratios, pole interpretations, period and approximate model scale
sourceSurvey.reason: Published numerical light-curve model; no re-fitting or invented terrain.
Unresolved spectra do not provide spatially registered surface texels.
The overview identifies spectral and imaging observations, not a released global surface map; no texture is inferred from the program description.

radiusMeaning: Volume-equivalent radius of the selected displayed model; not an independently measured mean radius.
reuse: Numeric measurements and authored interpretation with primary citations. Downloaded papers are local research references, not surface assets.
